name: NCSA Delta
description: Data-only community profile for the NCSA Delta system; distinct from DeltaAI.

site.access_note: A Delta allocation and NCSA identity with Duo MFA are required. This profile describes NCSA Delta, not DeltaAI.

access.access_note: Use the NCSA username, password, and Duo MFA. No credential is stored by this package.

project.label: NCSA project
project.help: Use only a project assigned to the user's active Delta allocation.

account.label: Delta account
account.help: Use the NCSA/ACCESS account assigned to the user; account values are not bundled.

scheduler_hints.queue_notes: NCSA documents the listed CPU and GPU partitions. Limits and availability can change; check the current Delta guide before submission. Interactive partitions are intended for short debugging and prototyping.
scheduler_hints.account_notes: Use the account assigned to the active Delta allocation. Do not reuse an account value from another site or user.

software.setup_notes: NCSA's Delta job guidance uses Slurm. Current job-script examples say `module reset` populates WORK and SCRATCH. Verify those allocation-specific paths in the active Delta environment before using them.

policy.cleanup_note: The current guide identifies the HOME filesystem as /u. No per-user quota is pinned in this package.
NCSA job examples populate WORK after `module reset`; the resolved allocation path is not guessed.
NCSA job examples populate SCRATCH after `module reset`; verify the resolved path and current policy in the active Delta environment.
